name: fondaro
description: Work your real estate leads from ChatGPT: leads, notes, tasks, deals, brochures and property search, as yourself, with your agency's access.

interface.longDescription:
Fondaro is the CRM for real estate agencies. Every lead in one place, one click to call from your browser or phone, with an assistant that tells you who to call next.

Connect Fondaro and ask ChatGPT to find a lead, add a note or a task, move a deal, check who on your team is free for a viewing, search the property sites of your market and build a brochure for a buyer. ChatGPT works as you: it sees what you can see in Fondaro, and every change lands on the lead's record with your name on it.

Calls and emails stay with you. ChatGPT never dials, never sends an email or message, and never moves money. It can read call transcripts and email history you already have, and it drafts the words for you to send yourself.

What you can do:
- Leads: search, read the timeline, update status, contact details, tags and who it is assigned to
- Notes and tasks: add, change and complete them
- Deals: create, move between stages, close won or lost, see the pipeline
- Calendar: your schedule and your team's free times
- Properties: search the property sites of your market and your agency's own sources, viewings and open houses
- Brochures and documents: build a brochure from listings, share documents with a lead
- Help: search the Fondaro help docs

Admins can also manage lead routing and queues. You sign in with your Fondaro account and can disconnect at any time in Settings, Integrations, Fondaro MCP.
defaultPrompt: Which of my new leads this week have not had a call yet?
Add a note to Ana Berg: wants a second viewing Friday. And a task to call her Thursday.
Who on my team has free time Tuesday afternoon for a viewing?

positive.prompt: Which of my new leads this week have not had a call yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists this week's new leads that have no call logged.

positive.prompt: Add a note to Ana Berg: loved the La Zagaleta villa, wants a second viewing Friday. And a task to call her Thursday.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Ana Berg, creates the note and a task due Thursday.

positive.prompt: Find detached villas in Marbella between €4M and €6M and make a brochure for Michael O'Brien.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches properties and creates a brochure with the chosen listings for that lead.

positive.prompt: Move the García deal to Reserved and show my pipeline by stage.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm, moves the deal, then lists deals by stage.

positive.prompt: Who on my team has free time Tuesday afternoon for a viewing?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns free slots per team member.

negative.prompt: Email this brochure to Michael O'Brien.
What's the weather in Marbella tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: Fondaro does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release. Fondaro's CRM tools for real estate agencies: leads, notes, tasks, deals, calendar and free times, property search, viewings, open houses, brochures, documents, help docs, and lead routing for admins. Sign-in with your Fondaro account.
